scientific_integrity: All statements reconstructed in an explicit analytic proof; numerical checker is supplemental, not a proof; independent audit unperformed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive biological parameters; infinite-variance stationary ergodic invasion exponent only. No sample-path rate, finite-time extinction probability, random-attractor convergence or uniform degenerate-parameter limit is claimed. Historical priority against unindexed Gaussian special-function asymptotics remains unresolved.
title: Logarithmically slow high-variance saturation of predator invasion under bounded Ornstein–Uhlenbeck refuge noise
